Include a wide range of contexts such as online reviews, customer support interactions, social media complaints, and direct emails. Use varied tones (e.g., angry, sarcastic, polite but critical, resigned) and highlight specific issues like defective products, long delays, rude staff, or billing errors. Incorporate subtle nuances, such as mixed feelings or partial satisfaction alongside criticism, to reflect complex real-world feedback. Include cultural or regional language variations (e.g., expressions of frustration) and domain-specific terms (e.g., tech glitches, retail return policies). Ensure text length varies from short, sharp comments to detailed multi-sentence complaints.
